messages:
Sanjay: Heads-up — noticed a bunch of tenants getting oscillating invoice preview totals this morning. looks like spikes every few minutes. #INC-4587
Maria: saw that too. seems correlated with the metering-staged-commit job. previews flip between two values after the compact step.
Ashley: can you paste an example tenant id and timestamps? I can pull the ledger events.
Sanjay: tenant: t-4382, preview at 08:12 = $23.41, then at 08:14 = $31.07, then 08:17 back to $23.41. logs show metering-staged-commit ran at 08:13 and 08:16.
billing-bot: alert: invoice-preview-delta (t-4382) 08:14 delta=+7.66 triggered rule preview-drift-threshold
Leo: odd — the staged-commit should be idempotent. my hunch: commit offsets are drifting because we align compaction to wall clock windows but routing service rewrites route_priority tag which changes aggregation key mid-batch.
Maria: that would cause double counting when we replay partial batches, right? one batch uses key A, compact runs, then later a rewrite arrives and a replay inserts key B entries that don't dedupe against A.
Oliver: concrete logs attached from the scheduler: ```
2026-04-12T08:12:49Z INFO staged-commit start seq=125432 batch_window_ms=120000 tenant=t-4382 key=prod:default
2026-04-12T08:13:01Z INFO compact applied seq=125432->125500 compacted_keys=1
2026-04-12T08:15:49Z INFO staged-commit start seq=125501 batch_window_ms=120000 tenant=t-4382 key=prod:high-prio
2026-04-12T08:16:05Z WARN replay inserted seq=125480 key=prod:high-prio duplicate_check=false
```
Courtney: that replay inserted an older seq after compact: duplicate_check=false? sounds like the dedupe flag isn't being set when the router does a tag rewrite. where is that flag set?
Ashley: it's set by the ingest-proxy at write-time. router's rewrite path currently re-emits events via the enrichment topic and doesn't mark them as dedupe-checked. we added that initially to speed up routing changes but maybe it bypasses the ledger guardrails.
Sanjay: timeline: routing change took effect at 08:14, router replayed ~20 events with new key. staged-commit executed compact at 08:13 on old key. result: preview shows both pre-compact and post-replay counts depending on which snapshot the preview service queried.
Leo: possible fixes: (1) router should set dedupe flag when re-emitting, (2) staged-commit compaction should be key-agnostic and consult event provenance to collapse semantically equal records, or (3) preview service should always materialize from finalized sequence numbers only. tradeoffs?
Maria: (1) seems smallest change but requires tight coupling with router team and might miss historical replays. (2) is safer but compute-heavy. (3) means previews lag behind by a window — UX hit.
Courtney: add a temporary mitigation: when preview sees toggling values within N minutes, it should surface "under reconciliation" and freeze displayed total while we fix root cause. that reduces churning for customers.
Oliver: I can open a quick PR to set dedupe=true in router re-emits. PR draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/router/pull/812 — adds dedupe flag and a unit test for replay flow.
Sanjay: thank you. can we also add a debug counter in metering-staged-commit so we can track how often we compact before/after rewrite events? helps validate.
Ashley: will prototype the counter and a preview freeze state. I'll also file a small telemetry alert: if preview delta > 20% within 5m and staged-commit ran during that window, page oncall.
billing-bot: ticket created: INC-4587 linked -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4587 (labels: metering, router, billing)
Leo: timeline proposal: router dedupe flag + counter instrumentation -> hotfix this week; longer-term: compaction logic audit and preview finalization SLA in Q2.
Maria: sounds good. I'll coordinate with router and billing SREs. tagging @channel in the follow-up thread once PRs are up. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: excellent. leaving logs and tenant dump in the incident folder. thanks all.
